coverage_notes.scope: Bounded supplementary recall watch only; production collection remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption identified in the search window.
notes: Targeted searches covered sole/only/last/full-service grocery loss, disaster-canceled food distributions, abrupt pantry/food-bank access reductions, and official SNAP/WIC interruptions.
Fresh search results did not surface an event first reported within the window that met the watch criteria.

El Pasoans Fighting Hunger Food Bank storm-damage coverage was published September 28 at 1:30 PM CDT and described a closure that began the prior Thursday, so it predates this window and was excluded.
Older grocery-store and pantry disruption results were excluded as outside the window or duplicates.
